instruction: Highlight the paper title in cell A2 with a background color to make it stand out.

parameters.window_name: New Large Language Models.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc

metadata.explanation: Task requires highlighting cell A2 (QWEN TECHNICAL REPORT) with any background color. The evaluator checks if cell A2 has a non-white fill color applied, allowing flexibility in color choice.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts background fill color from cell A2 using openpyxl
Metric appropriately checks for any non-white background color, allowing flexibility in color choice as per instruction
Postconfig includes file save (Ctrl+S) to ensure changes are persisted before evaluation
Evaluator provides complete coverage: instruction requires highlighting cell A2, evaluator checks if cell A2 has highlighting
Data flow is semantically correct: getter extracts color hex string, metric validates it's not white/no-fill
Handles both RGB and indexed color formats from openpyxl
Edge case handling: returns None if file doesn't exist, filters out common white color representations
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The white color detection covers common formats (00000000, FFFFFFFF, 00FFFFFF) but may miss some edge cases like slightly off-white colors - this is acceptable for most practical scenarios
